runtimeContract.browser: Playwright Chromium drives the production dashboard UI without page.route or route.fulfill in the real-db project.
runtimeContract.http: The real Express dashboard, OAuth callback, session middleware, AuthZ middleware and production v2 routers handle every request.
runtimeContract.database: A PostgreSQL service receives real Prisma migrations, seeds, queries and mutations.
runtimeContract.externalBoundary: Only Discord OAuth/user/guild HTTP responses and the Discord client gateway object are simulated at the server boundary; no dashboard API or database operation is mocked.

realDbTests.name: real authenticated settings action commits one DB side effect
realDbTests.proof: OAuth login/callback creates Session and OAuthToken rows; UI PATCH updates ServerSettings and creates exactly one DONE IdempotencyKey plus one AuditLog row.

realDbTests.name: real AuditLog search/filter/cursor appends page two without loss
realDbTests.proof: The UI reads 55 PostgreSQL AuditLog rows through the production API, applies search/category/guild filters and appends the second cursor page.

realDbTests.name: DB revocation reaches the real UI as 401 without false success
realDbTests.proof: Revoking the persisted Session makes the production mutation return 401, renders the error state and leaves ServerSettings unchanged.

realDbTests.name: real authenticated desktop routes render DB-backed state
realDbTests.proof: Desktop server list, guild and settings routes render authenticated PostgreSQL-backed state without horizontal overflow.

realDbTests.name: real DB-backed settings route remains usable at every required width
realDbTests.proof: The authenticated production route renders controls and navigation without horizontal overflow at 320, 360, 375, 390 and 430 px.
